description: Everything about ONE station, including what its device last reported about itself — app version, OS, network, printer, battery and whatever else that device sends. THIS IS THE TOOL FOR 'the till will not connect', 'it will not print', 'the card reader is not working', 'this register is acting up'. Takes the station id from get_stations, never a name. How to read it when troubleshooting: `kind` tells you whether it is a physical device or a browser till (a browser till has no device to blame — check the share link and the flow instead); an empty `deviceId` on a native station means no device ever enrolled under it; `enrolledBy` and `createdAt` say who set it up and when; an empty `deviceEnvironment` means the device has never reported anything, which is itself the finding. The values carry NO timestamp — they are the last ones received, and there is no way to tell how old they are. `recordUpdatedAt` is the last time the station RECORD changed (mostly a shift opening or closing, or a rename) — it is NOT a heartbeat: the platform stores no online/offline ping for a till, so never report a station as "online" or "last seen". Card readers shown here are read-only: pairing and unpairing a reader happens on the Terminals screen of the cabinet, not through any tool.
